free_tier.stated: 5000 requests a day at 2 requests a second and 60 requests a minute, across the Geocoding, Routing and Street and Static Maps APIs, with 2 access tokens
free_tier.notes: the next plan, Developer, is USD 100 a month for 25,000 requests a day at 20 requests a second; the terms call the free account a trial that may be charged for later

per_object_cap.stated: no batch endpoint: one address or coordinate a request; bulk work is sent as concurrent requests within the plan's per-second rate

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in requests, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS to us1.locationiq.com/v1/search with an API access token (prefix pk.), served from US and EU datacenters; a request with no valid key answers HTTP 401 {"error":"Invalid key"}; a request over a per-second, per-minute or daily limit answers HTTP 429
chaining: 5000 storable geocodes, reverse geocodes or routes a day on an email account with no card; bulk geocoding is sent as concurrent single requests at up to 2 a second, since no batch endpoint exists

limits.value: 5000 requests a day on the Free plan
2 requests a second and 60 requests a minute on the Free plan
request-response pairs cached for up to 48 hours on a free account; response data itself may be stored with no limit

binding_note: 2 requests a second and 60 a minute allow more than 5000 requests in a day, so the daily quota is met first

identity_cost.detail: an account at my.locationiq.com with a work email, a full name and a use case, or Google sign-in; the form has no card field. Whether a free-mail address passes as a work email is…

reliability_note: a request over the per-second, per-minute or daily limit answers HTTP 429; the free account is described as a trial that may be charged for later
